newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-CRICKET-NZ 17-2 after Sri Lanka win toss.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-CRICKET-NZ 17-2 after Sri Lanka win toss.

text.p: Sri Lanka took two quick wickets after winning the toss and asking New Zealand to bat on Thursday in the second and final one-day cricket international.
Both openers went with the score on 17.
Nathan Astle slashed wildly and was caught at third man off the bowling of Nuwan Zoysa. In the next over, Bryan Young fell lbw to Chaminda Vaas.

New Zealand, expecting the pitch at Wellington's Basin Reserve to assist the seam bowlers, left out spinner Daniel Vettori and brought in swing bowler Andrew Penn, 22, to make his international debut.
Sri Lanka, who won Tuesday's match in Christchurch by six wickets, named an unchanged lineup.
New Zealand - Stephen Fleming (captain), Nathan Astle, Bryan Young, Matt Horne, Chris Cairns, Chris Harris, Adam Parore, Gavin Larsen, Simon Doull, Heath Davis, Andrew Penn

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Roshan Mahanama, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekaratne, Kumar Dharmasena, Upul Chandana, Chaminda Vaas, Nuwan Zoysa, Muttiah Muralitharan
